raw_text: Recorded Future's analysis of the North Eastern grid attack confirms a sophisticated cyber-physical operation. Malware found in two Bongaigaon substation SCADA systems was designed to manipulate relay protection settings, creating artificial frequency deviations that triggered cascading load-shedding. The malware exhibited similarities to tools used in previous grid attacks globally. POSOCO's emergency islanding response successfully contained the cascading failure.
clean_text: Recorded Future confirms sophisticated cyber-physical attack on NE grid. Malware at Bongaigaon SCADA manipulated relays causing cascading failure. POSOCO islanding contained the attack.
